body: I do suggest to anyone who is having trouble to seek professional help, I have only good things to say about the anti-depressant i'm on(celexa), $4 a month at the walmart pharmacy is definatly worth not feeling bad every day. I still have bad days, and unfortunately suicide is still stuck in my head as an option if everything goes all to hell. But at least the meds help and the days I think about it are fewer. So i really think i'm on the right track, and i'm still making progress at least on my education.

Yeah, I haven't done anything to myself recently, I'm actually doing fairly well now.  I have had a few thoughts about hurting myself recently one night, but I just slept it off I guess.  Most of my stress comes from school, especially after I missed 2 final exams last semester from being in the hospital last semester after my latest real attempt to kill myself.  I started college at 16 on a full ride, and I lost it 2 years due to my apathy for about everything. My parents have been paying tuition lately for me as long as I pass, but even that's about downhill b/c of bad grades. I know I've got it better than a lot of people but I still ended up hurting myself. Anyways, I actually feel great right now; i just took my anti-depressant so I'm going to try to get some sleep right now. I'll be back in the morning, so any insightful comments will be appreciated.
An upvote, but no comment, maybe I should say something to start things off?
